title: Preserve native history when relocating a stopped Vibez checkout
objective: Relocate verified, quiescent and completed native history within the same GitHub project, preserving original runtime and provenance bytes.
inScope: Add trusted native history export and activation anchored to the exact verified source and destination.
Document the stopped-writer handoff, compatibility checks and rollback.
Validate the actual WSL migration without committing runtime records.
outOfScope: Configured storage, active or external sessions, manual exchange, driver history, repeat relocation, cross-project imports, AUT-002 implementation and package release publication.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: Validate the source snapshot and same-project destination before activation, including owner-confirmed quiescence and explicit snapshot and manifest digests.
AC-02: Preserve original records and audit provenance byte-for-byte. Validate imported receipts alongside new destination evidence.
AC-03: Reject foreign, edited, missing, colliding, or unpinned histories and unsupported scopes. Activation is durable and safely repeatable.
AC-04: Document Windows-to-WSL handoff and rollback limits. No runtime state, credentials, or live transfer manifests are tracked.
AC-05: Pass fresh independent QA, Architecture, and UAT reviews and exact-head CI, then merge through the protected native controller. Retain validation and operational restore evidence.
validationPlan: Run full README build, test, schema, provenance, and adversarial checks on WSL 2.
Exercise exact original and destination digests, bad provenance, same-repository ancestry, interrupted or duplicate activation, and rollback refusal in disposable repositories.
Inspect a separately installed candidate against the stopped original and the verified offline WSL restore. Obtain independent QA, Architecture and UAT reviews and protected exact-head integration.
